decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the eastern wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - Subject to appropriate safeguarding conditions, The proposal, because of its size, design and appearance, is considered to be acceptable having due regard to the site characteristics, and would not harm the appearance of the house or the area as a whole, or neighbours' living conditions.  The development, which would preserve the character and appearance of the conservation area, is therefore considered to comply with Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan and Supplementary Planning Guidance
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension in place of rear kitchen/ store incoporating internal and external alterations on first floor to house.
